text:
historical events that will never not be crazy, no matter how many times u read about them

1. Washington in 1776 getting 9,000 troops over the East River in the dead of night, aided by a thick fog. 100% changed the course of history

2. everything about Napoleon's 1812 in Moscow...Ney holding off Chichagov after crossing the Berezina...the aftermath in Vilnius, u could do a 50-bullet post on this alone (one that doesn't even include Elba, Egyptian campaign, and more etc)

3. everything about the French Revolution and how mob rule consistently proves to be more bloodthirsty and tyrannical than despotism

4. Hannibal crossing the Alps (plus not capitalizing on victory after Cannae)

5. Xenophon's "Ten Thousand" / Anabasis

6. everything about Dunkirk

7. Cortes + the Aztecs

8. Galileo during the Inquisition

9. everything about The Siege of Malta (La Valette, Dragut) + that era in general ("Four Princes")

10. St. Bartholomew Massacre (maybe Khmer Rouge + Great Leap should rank above this, idk)

what else
